argmax identities can hold vacuously — print the argmax value beside the identity (won by +.02 vs lost-by-least at .000); a ridge of forfeits prescribes abstain, a ridge of wins prescribes tune

ties hide swaps — break every feature tie per-item before deleting the loser (equal means, different misses); velocity is an early-only feature, not a second feature

ordered locals are one law with a parameter: bar-top rises as LR falls (bar(LR) monotone) — always sort dissolved addresses by the variable that broke them before declaring separate regimes
a healthy verdict on an easy readout is worth nothing until a hard readout concurs — in1/in4 passed all six cells here, sick or not; cell claims ship with their readout
a hold is a protocol address: s18 coasts 800 after consol400@400-800 but erodes from step 200 after consol200@800-1000 — never quote a hold without its consol (restore address + length + recut)
count the minima before fitting the forces: one minimum = two forces, two minima = three forces or an oscillator — a second hole past the first healing is a second mechanism until proven otherwise

a mixture weight is a new bank with its own physics (variance-mismatch inflation), not a blend — never interpolate validity numbers across w; scope amendment needs a mixture clause (any w in (0,1) reads above .028, up to ~.04)
rules of form x+k*se(x) all die at x=0 (tau=0 auto-fires) — a threshold ships with its zero-behavior stated; a floor term is the form's own completion, not a third mechanism

a schedule's phase resolution is its finest sampling grid — a reset between audit ticks is bit-exactly invisible; lead the onset (fresh in-phase estimates), straddle the offset (re-learn familiar fast)

a repair that meets the aggregate bar while the worst cell barely moves measured the wrong thing — ship the constraint as a diagnostic and follow the unmoved cell (trn@50: collective order inversion, z-shift artifact candidate)
a restart policy's bill ships as three lines (discard cost, kept capital, fresh-world tax) — optimizing the discard while the fresh-world tax dominates just moves the loss

a shape claim needs the fill at the resolution the shape implies — quote points not curves until interior runs; fixed-window readouts phase-slice moving dips (extend the window before naming the outcome)
when bracketing a transition, first cells go in the gap between last-live and first-dead — the seam lives between evidences, never past the last one

a retired knob haunts its coarser bin at no cost (odd rest .04 = b65 leaking, capture unchanged) — retirements propagate upward as ghost preferences; check whether a flipping bin contains a harder-flipping retired sub-bin

adjacent-vs-distant dissenter rule: before theorizing a swap, print each dissenter's rank-distance to the boundary — adjacent (|Δ|≤2) dissenters get a threshold story, distant ones get a mechanism story, and the two must not share a conclusion

extremum-over-window rule: an argmax address over a grid window is a property of the window until both edges are explored — extend until the max is interior with measured neighbors, or ship it with the word censored attached

treatment-must-touch-it rule: a generality probe lists per arm reads-axis vs constant-in-axis before running — constants replicate by entailment (free receipt), movers earn the grid (second instance of the meter moral)

stream-prefix rule: phases sharing one bootstrap stream must replay the FULL consumption prefix in order — a phase-local replay is a different stream wearing the same seed (seeds name streams only with their history)
censoring-with-resolution-date rule: every censored label ships with the measurement that uncensors it (which delay/cell, what both outcomes mean) — unscheduled censoring is hedging

slice-before-pool rule: the first table is the cross-tab (fixed-B ladders + fixed-LR runs), never the pooled scatter — pooling assigns interior variance to the envelope variable and manufactures inversions
spot-is-extremum rule: blind-spot size headlines the MAX gap, never the mean — averaging a cliff with its healthy doses reports the dilution (s10-const mean .1225 < s10-fade .1788 while max doubles))

peaked-ladder rule: when the middle wins under a monotone pre-reg, stop fitting the axis and cross it with the next variable already in the design — peaked outcomes are confound signatures (restore address was in the cells all along)
readout-address rule: a cell with disagreeing readouts has no verdict, only an address — cells ship as (readout, value) pairs; readout-conditionality IS the verdict's address (third instance)
headroom-canary rule: under a perturbation probe, order cells by (bar - value) and spend the finest grid on the smallest headrooms — the max cell breaks first (fourth instance of the max moral)

pair-modifications rule: price every modification on the baseline's streams (same seeds/order) — unpaired dent-pricing measures streams, not thresholds (flrB zero dent is an identity, not an estimate)
per-seed-argmin rule: every pooled optimum ships its per-seed argmin table — an optimum losing 2-3/6 outright is a recommendation with a roster, not a setting (fifth slice-before-pool instance)

loop-manufactured-order rule: when resub is flat (b1~=0) and LOO is perfectly inverted, an AUC of exactly 0.000 is a structure not an estimate — validate the loop (frozen variants, resub baseline) before theorizing the data (W317: resub .485 chance, LOO 0.000 exact, frozen-z 0.000)

price-the-climb rule: when max config is always eventually needed, any adaptive climb is pure overhead — a config policy's cost is the integral of the climb, not the price of the destination (W318: maxed wins 30x; the 2 zero-tail cells decide whether climbing ever earns its keep)

both-sides-of-the-dip rule: a shape claim needs the readout AFTER the readout — extend the window past the extremum before naming the outcome; a readout that fires once is a rumor (W319: cut75 1.0@300, .79@400, .9667@500)

degenerate-optimum rule: when the winner is the do-nothing endpoint, the finding is the crossing (which cap, which pT), never the winner — a degenerate optimum is an argmax artifact, not a discovery (W320: ridgeM=1.0 everywhere past forfeit; forfeit begins the moment mean-diff crosses 0)

price-the-knob rule: a refit that moves the knob but not the loss retires the knob — stability audits end in prices, not taus (W321: halves disagree .04 vs 0, price 1.3e-5, four orders below pooled price)

floor-not-feature rule: a predictor's resolution is set by the room above the readout — the same slope means more where less remains to climb; blindness is a property of the floor (W322: slope AUC .556 low-start vs .86-.98 mid/high; ceilings sharpen, floors smear)

interior-promotion rule: a ladder with broken ends is a window not a law — promote the interior, extend past the ends; any argmax sitting on a grid edge ships with censored attached (W323: middle three rungs a finding, the law pending W340; D6 flat profile = tie-break readout)

mover-pricing rule: the receipt tells you where NOT to spend (constants replicate by entailment); the mover grid tells you what the axis is worth — even a barely-moving mover earns its runs (W324: clampLM reads PADN, axis worth ~.02 with a consistent PADN3 dent pending W341)

escapee-address rule: a budget with an unpinned member is a direction not a number — report (pinned-max, escapee-address), never average a pointer with numbers (W325: budget (>16000) = (15516, s2-mid.0071))
own-dips rule: a period claim needs the cell's OWN dips twice running — shared delays count toward geography, not the interval (W326: D25 system-wide; D75 decides with no system event)

retained-gap rule: a dimple that fills halfway to the bar with doubled n but keeps a >=.15 gap is MORE confirmed, not less — the direction of the wobble is weather, the retained gap is the finding (W327: B24 .45->.60, neighbors +.18)

bisection-to-mapping rule: the first probe that breaks monotonicity converts the wave from bisection to mapping — stop narrowing, start gridding (W328: sick-clean-sick retires the cliff address; W345 grids seeds x fine-auxW)

one-rung separator rule: when two shapes differ by one rung's direction, run that rung first and alone — the cheapest separating wave is one cell, not a ladder (W329: restore600 decides dip-vs-cliff; the two receipts rode free)

rescue-order rule: a dose ladder lifting one readout gradeably while another sits flat-then-jumps is two mechanisms, not one dose-response — report separate curves sharing an x-axis, never one averaged slope (W330: t1000-rescue + ladder-crater; t1000 first, ladder later-or-never)

crossing-not-address rule: a break claim needs a SHAPE (jump/kink/acceleration), not a bar-crossing — any monotone grade crosses every bar somewhere, and that somewhere is the bar's address, not the system's (W331: +50% at .05 is arrival, not structure)
